visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all99 final images:16 portable,16 shared,32 medium-fi and35 retained-terrain views. The stepped castle retains Royal Palace and its octagonal clock turret, Great Hall, Queen Anne range, War Memorial, chapel, New Barracks, Governor and Hospital ranges, Half Moon and Argyle batteries, Crown Square and Hospital Square. Owner plan and courtyard photographs establish their arrangement, roof colors, guns and narrow suspended memorial-palace arch. Both entrance vaults are genuinely open at all detail levels. Portcullis orientation is corrected from mapped passage endpoints rather than the former arbitrary yaw. The drawbridge and winding cobbled road are continuous. Owner visual-story pages7–11 establish the entrance and steep route. Corrected tapered tubes restore gun wheels and the slender pole. Gates, windows and trim are grouped exterior geometry; sculptures and inscriptions are omitted.

legacyFidelityScope.notes: Maximum fidelity is pending. Courtyard elevations, heights, roof junctions, opening positions, and gatehouse fit are reconstructed rather than surveyed. Master includes architectural niches, stonework, window frames, guns and crenellations; statues, memorial carvings, heraldic shields and inscriptions are not faithful sculptural reproductions. Castle Rock is represented only by provisional stepped retaining plinths. No claim of terrain fit, exact geology, interiors, trees or temporary esplanade installations. The palace turret clock is static. Dormers, precisely stepped gables, decorative ridge pieces, Foogs Gate and individual roof details still need close-reference refinement. Shared sandstone, raw limestone, weathered limestone, slate, ceramic chimney pots, timber and painted metal; PBR glazing. No embedded images.
